title: Resin Bound Driveway
intro: A new 55m² resin bound driveway replacing the existing gravel, with a contrasting block border and the bush by the entrance removed.

scope.heading: The works
items: Remove the existing gravel and the bush by the entrance
Excavate to formation and remove all spoil
New permeable sub-base and resin bound surface, 55m²
150 × 50mm concrete edgings to all open edges

finishes: Resin: chosen from samples on the visit. Border: charcoal block.

spec_stages.title: Set out and protect
spec_stages.text: Levels and lines set out, adjoining surfaces and the house protected.

spec_stages.title: Excavate
spec_stages.text: Dug to formation, spoil removed from site, formation compacted.

spec_stages.title: Sub-base
spec_stages.text: Geotextile laid, then 150mm of free-draining stone laid and compacted in layers.

spec_stages.title: Base
spec_stages.text: Permeable base laid to falls away from the house.

spec_stages.title: Resin bound surface
spec_stages.text: 18mm resin bound aggregate mixed on site and hand-trowelled.

spec_stages.title: Clean and hand over
spec_stages.text: Site cleared and swept, aftercare explained.

buildups.name: Driveway build-up
buildups.note: Permeable throughout — rain soaks through to the ground.

options.name: Resin bound driveway
options.summary: 55m² resin bound with block border, all groundworks and waste removal.

lines.description: Resin bound driveway, complete as specified
LED step lights, supplied and fitted

included: Removal of rock and buried obstructions
